decisions.reason: As management we would likely keep it for now because it is only in its second year and already publicly launched, even though its fit with our core warehousing and transport-support business is relatively weak and the commitment appears limited to a website offering.

As management we would likely keep it because the service is still new, has already been publicly committed to, and its maritime crewing angle is somewhat closer to our transport-related activities, making it easier to justify continued support despite uncertainty.
